page.title: Alipay website payment
page.intro: Direct merchant integration · RSA2 public-key mode. Enter the Alipay public key, not the application public key. No service-provider authorization token is required.
page.enable_warning: Before enabling this channel, complete query, refund, bill, and live-provider acceptance. Saving settings does not mean acceptance is complete. The global purchase switch is in Product and purchase settings.
help.secrets: The application private key and Alipay public key are encrypted and never shown again. Leave fields blank to keep saved values; select Clear to delete them. PEM and raw Base64 keys are supported. Custom width applies only to mode 4 and is limited by this site.
help.urls: The asynchronous notification confirms payment. The application gateway is a separate notification endpoint. The return URL is only for returning the browser to a page. The payment environment selects the production or sandbox gateway.
status.saved: Alipay settings saved. The channel still requires launch acceptance.
error.alipay_configuration_incomplete: Enter the application ID, merchant PID, application private key, and Alipay public key before enabling the channel.
error.alipay_key_invalid: Invalid key format. Use a 2048–4096 bit RSA PEM or Base64 key.
error.alipay_identity_invalid: The application ID or merchant PID format is invalid.
error.alipay_callback_url_invalid: Callback URLs must use an allowed HTTPS domain on this site and the required fixed path.
error.alipay_setting_invalid: Invalid settings. Check the QR mode and width.
error.permission_denied: You do not have permission to manage payment settings.
error.csrf_invalid: Your session expired. Sign in again.
error.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.generic: Settings were not saved. Check the configuration or sign in again.
